item.tib: dbal chen drag po rngam pa'i thugs rgyud las byad thag bcad pa lha lam dmu thag
item.coloph: byad thag bcad pa dkar nag shan 'byed srid pa'i drang shing zhes bya ba 'di/ rtogs 'dud can rnams kyis bskul ngor/ bon sgo gzhan dang mthun phyir/ bkra shis ri khrod du shing mo lug gi zla tshes rig 'dzin gsang sngags grags pas legs par bkod pa'i mthus/ 'gro kun bar chod ma lus sel bar shog don 'gal 'khrul pa mchis na/ lha dang bla ma rnams la bshags gsol lo//
